listings.core: Star Wars Cards Stickers and Wonder Bread Lot 32 Original Run
listings.current_title: 1977 Topps Star Wars Cards Stickers and Wonder Bread Lot 32 Original Run Vintage
listings.description_original:
A lot of 32 original 1977 Star Wars items. This includes 23 Topps trading cards from series 1 through 4 in blue, red,
yellow and green, among them Harrison Ford as Han Solo number 58, Mark Hamill as Luke Skywalker number 57, Peter Cushing
as Grand Moff Tarkin number 60, R2 D2 number 253, Princess Leia number 221 and Ben Kenobi number 249. It also includes 2
orange series 5 stickers, Chewbacca number 46 and C 3PO and R2 D2 number 47. Also included are 7 Wonder Bread Star Wars
cards, Ben Kenobi, Grand Moff Tarkin, Chewbacca, Jawas, Tusken Raiders, Star Destroyer and X Wing. Typical play wear for the
age, with some creasing on the Wonder Bread cards. Shipped with care and tracking.

listings.core: Empire Strikes Back Near Complete Set 329 Cards Stickers in Binder
listings.current_title: 1980 Topps Empire Strikes Back Near Complete Set 329 Cards Stickers in Binder
listings.description_original: A near complete collection of 1980 Topps The Empire Strikes Back trading cards and stickers, stored one item per pocket in a 38 page, 9 pocket, 3 ring zippered binder with orange spine, binder included. Series 1 red border cards, numbers 1 to 132, are complete. Series 2 blue border cards, numbers 133 to 264, are complete, including the Movie Facts behind the scenes cards, numbers 251 to 262, and both checklist cards. Series 1 stickers are 32 of 33, missing only number 26. Series 2 stickers are complete at 33 of 33. That is 329 items in all with no duplicates. Highlights include the Series 2 introduction card, Boba Fett and Yoda and Darth Vader Star File cards, and Boba Fett and Luke Skywalker stickers. An easy way to own nearly the entire vintage Star Wars set, already organized and display ready. Condition is Very Good, from a private collection and ungraded. Photos show the actual cards. Shipped with care and tracking.

listings.core: Empire Strikes Back Series 1 Lot 53 Cards Star Wars Official Data
listings.current_title: 1980 Topps Empire Strikes Back Series 1 Lot 53 Cards Star Wars Official Data
listings.description_original:
A lot of 53 Series 1 red border cards from the 1980 Topps The Empire Strikes Back set, covering 44 different card
numbers between 7 and 132. Includes Official Data cards for Artoo Deeto, Yoda, Darth Vader and Boba Fett, Story Digest cards,
and the Series 1 checklist. Some numbers appear more than once. A good start for finishing a set or for a collector who wants
Empire Strikes Back cards in bulk. Shipped with care.
